title: Middle Level Education, B.S. — English 4-8 Option (College of Education)
notes: English 4-8 Option, University Park (of three content areas: English, Mathematics, Social Studies -- English chosen as the cleanest). Actively accepting students (unlike Elementary and Kindergarten Education, logged as blocked in BLOCKED_MAJORS.md for being on hold since 2010). Extended ci_catalog.json with CI 295B/495B and lled_catalog.json with LLED 450. Generalized CI 495D's prereq to accept either CI 495A (PK-4, used by Elementary and Early Childhood Education) or CI 495B (Middle Level, used here) -- each major's own plan only ever schedules the one applicable to its own track, so the OR-group correctly serves both without a hard-coded major-specific exception. Real gap fixed: 'LLED 402: Teaching Children's Literature' has no separate course description anywhere in the catalog beyond being cited as a corequisite of LLED 400 -- since it shares an identical title with the already-cataloged 'LLED 302: Teaching Children's Literature', treated the two as the same course (a bare-vs-suffixed numbering mismatch, same class of judgment call as several bare-vs-W-suffix cases earlier this session). Real gap fixed: 'LLED 450' needs EDPSY 14, which the English 4-8 option's own suggested plan never otherwise schedules (only the Math and Social Studies options include it) -- added EDPSY 14 as an explicit Semester 1 item. Verified 2026-08-26 against the live bulletin's English 4-8 option table (isolated from the Math/Social Studies option tables it shares a page with) and Penn State College of Education's own real, published course-selection lists (ed.psu.edu 'undergraduate middle level english course selections', mirrored at sites.psu.edu/educationadvising/course-lists/mdlveng/). Two real requirements were missing entirely: 'American Literature Selection' (3cr) and 'Comparative Literature Selection' (3cr) -- the bulletin's Second Year Fall term requires both alongside the plan's existing plain 'Literature Selection', and neither existed anywhere in this plan; added both to Semester 3 with the department's real approved course lists wired via `match`. Also missing: a 'Mathematics Selection' (3cr, GQ) item -- the bulletin requires MATH 200 (already scheduled) plus one additional 'any MATH GQ' course in Third Year Spring; added to Semester 6, wired to gen_ed GQ. 'Literature Selection', 'British Literature', 'Writing Selection', and 'Media Selection' (x2, matching the bulletin's real 'select two' Media Literacy requirement) are now wired via `match` to the department's real, published per-category course lists from the same source (British/American/Comparative/Writing/Media Literacy share one footnote; plain 'Literature Selection' uses the college-wide list also used by Elementary and Early Childhood Education, at ed.psu.edu's 'elementary-early-childhood-education-bs-pk-4/suggested-courses' page). 'Earth Science Selection'/'Physical Science Selection' remain generic Gen Ed GN slots (already correctly wired); no real department-specific Biological/Earth/Physical Science course list could be transcribed with confidence (see ELED's notes for the identical source-quality issue).
